hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$c" | grep -qE 'herdr (pane split|pane move [^|]*--new-tab|agent start)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A new pane was just created. Before continuing: check the tab layout is still 4 panes per tab in a 2x2 grid, opening a new tab instead of crowding a 5th pane in. Run herdr tab get on the affected tab and rebalance if it has drifted."}}'; fi
